summary: Add release-build sustained-write acceptance for collection membership paging

compatibility.detail: An explicit ignored acceptance test uses 1001 agents, 4096 live memberships, limit 200 and twenty local-transport loads while offering 100 unrelated commits per second for ten seconds. Production Rust decoding and joining publish without new unchanged-window frames.

manual.detail: Run cargo test --release -p fractal-api-client-v0 collection_paging_sustained_unrelated_writes_release -- --ignored --nocapture on the chosen release runner. The test records its committed write rate and initial-load p95.

recovery.detail: A commit barrier separates every pair of page requests. A slow or prematurely stopped writer invalidates the run; the test does not claim sustained-rate acceptance unless its rate and latency gates both pass. No capability is advertised here.
